zoe-cs: Morning crew — quick check on TidalWorks private/VPC onboarding. Renewal touchpoint in ~38 days; CS flagged risk because GCP CMEK rotation + delayed audit export. Need owners for the last mile.

marc-eng: Quick status: they use GCP KMS (Cloud KMS, HSM-backed). We need the service account email to grant cryptoKeyVersions.useToEncrypt and useToDecrypt roles. Also confirm VPC-SC constraints.

tidalworks-admin: Service account is tidal-collector@tidal-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com. VPC-SC enabled on the project, private services access in 10.50.0.0/24. We can add the service account to the key IAM. Rotation is managed by them at 90 days.

kevin-ops: Network side: I'll add a firewall allow egress 443 to siem.tidalworks.example (203.0.113.55) and provision a Serverless VPC Connector for our forwarder. Also will create a private DNS entry. ETA today.

amelia-ps: For audit logs they want Cloud Audit -> Pub/Sub -> SIEM. We require a push subscription with JWT auth. Do they accept our push endpoint with client cert?

tidalworks-admin: Yes, we can accept our cert. We'll whitelist the collector IP in their firewall and confirm Pub/Sub subscription ack. Retention policy: 18 months with monthly snapshots.

deploy-bot: deployment/tidalworks-privnet env=staging status=success ts=1745056800 :rocket:

marc-eng: KMS policy snippet for them to add:
```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding tidal-key --location=global --keyring=prod-kr --member=serviceAccount:tidal-collector@tidal-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
```
Please confirm once applied.

kevin-ops: Ran a quick smoke: Pub/Sub push delivered, SIEM received test event, KMS decrypt OK. Logs show collector cert subject=CN=redwood-collector. Test ts=1745056820

zoe-cs: Awesome — I'm marking renewal risk as Low now. If anything regresses, flag me and I'll reopen the renewal note. Please add :white_check_mark: when you've added the KMS binding and updated the runbook. Runbook draft: https://intra/docs/cs/tidalworks-privnet-runbook (private).
